name: build-dependency
body: A dependency needed to compile and stage a frontend: a compiler or toolchain (`go`, `cargo`+`rustc`, `javac`, `node`+`npm`, `gcc`+`g++`, `dotnet`), a package-resolution mechanism (Go module proxy, crates.io/git, npm, NuGet), and network access where the dependency is fetched rather than vendored. The base scanner additionally needs the prebuilt static liblbug and a linked OpenSSL.
